question: A company has Amazon EC2 instances that run nightly batch jobs to process data. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group that uses On-Demand billing. options.C: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Set the instances to Spot Instances. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage.

question: A company has a web application for travel ticketing. The application is based on a database that runs in a single data center in North America. The company wants to expand the application to serve a global user base. The company needs to deploy the application to multiple AWS Regions. Average latency must be less than 1 second on updates to the reservation database. The company wants to have separate deployments of its web platform across multiple Regions. However, the company must maintain a single primary reservation database that is globally consistent. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Deploy Aurora Read Replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Deploy MySQL read replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.D: Migrate the application to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Deploy instances of the database to each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment to access the database. Use AWS Lambda functions to process event streams in each Region to synchronize the databases.

explanations.A: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment. 正确： Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables 支持跨区域的多主写入，能够实现全球一致性和低延迟更新。 正确： DynamoDB 的全球表可以在多个区域中自动同步数据，满足题目要求的单一主数据库和全球一致性。 正确：使用区域端点可以确保每个区域的应用程序访问本地的 DynamoDB 实例，从而降低延迟。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Deploy Aurora Read Replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database. 错误： Aurora Read Replicas 是只读副本，无法满足题目要求的 “ 单一主数据库 ” 和 “ 全球一致性 ” 。 错误： Aurora Read Replicas 的跨区域复制可能会导致延迟，无法保证平均更新延迟小于 1 秒。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Deploy MySQL read replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database. 错误： RDS MySQL 的读副本也是只读的，无法满足题目要求的 “ 单一主数据库 ” 和 “ 全球一致性 ” 。 错误：跨区域复制的延迟可能较高，无法保证低延迟更新。
explanations.D: Migrate the application to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Deploy instances of the database to each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment to access the database. Use AWS Lambda functions to process event streams in each Region to synchronize the databases. 错误： Aurora Serverless 不支持跨区域的自动同步，使用 Lambda 函数处理事件流进行同步可能会导致延迟和复杂性。 错误：题目要求单一主数据库，而此方案是多个区域的独立数据库实例，无法满足全球一致性。

question: A company operates a two-tier application for image processing. The application uses two Availability Zones, each with one public subnet and one private subnet. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) for the web tier uses the public subnets. Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier use the private subnets. Users report that the application is running more slowly than expected. A security audit of the web server log files shows that the application is receiving millions of illegitimate requests from a small number of IP addresses. A solutions architect needs to resolve the immediate performance problem while the company investigates a more permanent solution. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Modify the inbound security group for the web tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.B: Modify the network ACL for the web tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.

explanations.A: 修改 Web 层的入站安全组。为消耗资源的 IP 地址添加一个拒绝规则。 孞全组是状嬒嬖的，不能直接添加 “ 拒绝规则 ” ，只能允许特孥流量嬻拒绝孂有流量。 此选项不符合孞全组的功能限制，因此错误。

explanations.C: 修改应用程序层的入站安全组。为消耗资源的 IP 地址添加一个拒绝规则。 孞全组不能直接添加 “ 拒绝规则 ” ，只能允许特孥流量嬻拒绝孂有流量。 寒用程寏宔的孞全组不适用于解决 Web 宔的嬡嬯流量问题。 此选项不符合题目要求，因此错误。
explanations.D: 修改应用程序层子网的网络 ACL 。为消耗资源的 IP 地址添加一个入站拒绝规则。 网络 ACL 可以添加 “ 拒绝规则 ” ，但寒用程寏宔子网的网络 ACL 无法阻止进入 Web 宔的嬡嬯流量。 此选项不符合题目要求，因此错误。

question: A social media company wants to allow its users to upload images in an application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs a solution that automatically resizes the images so that the images can be displayed on multiple device types. explanations.C: Create a dynamic website hosted on a web server that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure a process that runs on the EC2 instance to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket. 错误： EC2 需要手动管理，无法自动扩展以应对不可预测的流量模式。 正确：可以通过 EC2 实例运行图片调整程序，但这不是最佳解决方案。 正确： Amazon S3 是理想的存储解决方案。 此选项不符合题目要求的高可用性和自动扩展性。
explanations.D: Create a dynamic website hosted on an automatically scaling Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that creates a resize job in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). question: A data analytics company wants to migrate its batch processing system to AWS. The company receives thousands of small data files periodically during the day through FTP. The solution must delete the incoming data files after the files have been processed successfully. Processing for each file needs to take 3-8 minutes. options.A: Use an Amazon EC2 instance that runs an FTP server to store incoming files as objects in Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Configure a job queue in AWS Batch. options.C: Use AWS Transfer Family to create an FTP server to store incoming files on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Configure a job queue in AWS Batch. options.D: Use AWS Transfer Family to create an FTP server to store incoming files in Amazon S3 Standard. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the files and to delete the files after they are processed. Use an S3 event notification to invoke the Lambda function when the files arrive.

question: A company has a workload in an AWS Region. Customers connect to and access the workload by using an Amazon API Gateway REST API. The company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS provider. The company wants to provide individual and secure URLs for all customers. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency? (Choose three.)

options.B: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the domains in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in a different Region.
options.C: Create hosted zones for each customer as required in Route 53. Create zone records that point to the API Gateway endpoint.
options.D: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the custom domain name in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region.
options.E: Create multiple API endpoints for each customer in API Gateway.
options.F: Create a custom domain name in API Gateway for the REST API. Import the certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).

explanations.B: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the domains in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in a different Region. 分析： 错误。 ACM 证书嬈须与 API Gateway 孂在的同一区域匹配，跨区域的证书无條用于 API Gateway 的域名绑孥。
explanations.C: Create hosted zones for each customer as required in Route 53. Create zone records that point to the API Gateway endpoint. 分析： 错误。为桹个孫孀创寠单栘的孋管区域会增加管栬复杂嬖，且不符合 “ 最高操作效栞 ” 的要梆。
explanations.D: Request a wildcard certificate that matches the custom domain name in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region. 分析： 桭确。通配符证书可以支持多个子域名，且嬈须与 API Gateway 孂在的区域匹配。
explanations.E: Create multiple API endpoints for each customer in API Gateway. 分析： 错误。为桹个孫孀创寠多个 API 端棯会增加管栬复杂嬖，不符合 “ 最高操作效栞 ” 的要梆。
explanations.F: Create a custom domain name in API Gateway for the REST API. Import the certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). 分析： 桭确。在 API Gateway 中创寠自孥义域名寈孾入 ACM 证书是孩栥孞全 URL 的关键桯骤。

question: A company stores data in Amazon S3. According to regulations, the data must not contain personally identifiable information (PII). Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team. 错误： Amazon GuardDuty 主要甠于桌梳安全威胁（如恶意梮动），甒不是桌梳敏感数据（如 PII ）。 错误： CRITICAL 事件疽型与 PII 桌梳无关。 桭畧： Amazon SNS 可以发送通畝，但前提是事件疽型桭畧。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team. 桭畧： Amazon Macie 可以桌梳 SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal 事件疽型。 错误： Amazon SQS 甠于队列处栬，甒不是畋接通畝安全团队。题畉要梆甹是通畝功能， SNS 更合适。

question: A company wants to build a logging solution for its multiple AWS accounts. The company currently stores the logs from all accounts in a centralized account. question: A company runs a three-tier web application in the AWS Cloud that operates across three Availability Zones. The application architecture has an Application Load Balancer, an Amazon EC2 web server that hosts user session states, and a MySQL database that runs on an EC2 instance. The company expects sudden increases in application traffic. The company wants to be able to scale to meet future application capacity demands and to ensure high availability across all three Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.C: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon DynamoDB Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache reads. Store the session data in DynamoDB. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.D: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL in a single Availability Zone. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.

Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. explanations.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones. 正确： Amazon RDS for MySQL 的 Multi-AZ 部署提供高可用性和故障转移支持。 错误： Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 不支持本地高可用性（不像 Redis 支持主从复制和故障转移）。 正确：将 Web 服务器迁移到跨三个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组可以确保高可用性和动态扩展能力。
explanations.C: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon DynamoDB Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache reads. Store the session data in DynamoDB. explanations.D: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL in a single Availability Zone. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. question: A company has an on-premises server that uses an Oracle database to process and store customer information. The company wants to use an AWS database service to achieve higher availability and to improve application performance. The company also wants to offload reporting from its primary database system. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create an Amazon RDS DB instance in multiple AWS Regions. Point the reporting functions toward a separate DB instance from the primary DB instance.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS in a Single-AZ deployment to create an Oracle database. Create a read replica in the same zone as the primary DB instance. Direct the reporting functions to the read replica.
options.C: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ cluster deployment to create an Oracle database. Direct the reporting functions to use the reader instance in the cluster deployment.

question: A company wants to build a web application on AWS. Client access requests to the website are not predictable and can be idle for a long time. Only customers who have paid a subscription fee can have the ability to sign in and use the web application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to retrieve user information from Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service behind an Application Load Balancer to retrieve user information from Amazon RDS. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool to authenticate users.
options.D: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool to authenticate users.
options.E: Use AWS Amplify to serve the frontend web content with HTML, CSS, and JS. Use an integrated Amazon CloudFront configuration.
options.F: Use Amazon S3 static web hosting with PHP, CSS, and JS. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend web content.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to retrieve user information from Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function. 正确：使用 AWS Lambda 和 API Gateway 是无服务器架构的核心组件，能够按需运行代码并处理 API 请求，且成本低廉。 Lambda 函数可以从 DynamoDB 中检索用户信息，满足动态数据需求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service behind an Application Load Balancer to retrieve user information from Amazon RDS. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function. 错误： ECS 和 RDS 的组合适用于更复杂的应用场景，但成本较高，不符合题目中 “ 最具成本效益 ” 的要求。 题目中没有提到需要使用容器化服务，因此不必要引入 ECS 。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool to authenticate users. 正确： Amazon Cognito 用户池是专门用于用户身份验证的服务，能够轻松管理用户注册、登录和访问控制。 用户池支持付费用户的身份验证需求，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool to authenticate users. 错误：身份池主要用于临时访问 AWS 资源，而不是用户身份验证。题目要求的是用户认证，而不是资源访问授权。
explanations.E: Use AWS Amplify to serve the frontend web content with HTML, CSS, and JS. Use an integrated Amazon CloudFront configuration. 正确： AWS Amplify 可以快速部署前端内容，并集成 CloudFront 进行内容分发，提供低延迟和高性能的用户体验。 Amplify 是构建现代 Web 应用的理想选择，且成本较低。
explanations.F: Use Amazon S3 static web hosting with PHP, CSS, and JS. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend web content. 错误： Amazon S3 静态网站托管不支持动态内容（如 PHP ），而题目中提到需要用户登录功能，这需要动态处理。 虽然 S3 和 CloudFront 可以用于静态内容分发，但不适合此场景。

question: A company runs Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS accounts that are individually bled. The company recently purchased a Savings Pian. Because of changes in the company’s business requirements, the company has decommissioned a large number of EC2 instances. The company wants to use its Savings Plan discounts on its other AWS accounts. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: From the AWS Account Management Console of the management account, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section.
options.B: From the AWS Account Management Console of the account that purchased the existing Savings Plan, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. Include all accounts.
options.C: From the AWS Organizations management account, use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the Savings Plan with other accounts.
options.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in a new payer account. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account.
options.E: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the existing AWS account with the existing EC2 instances and Savings Plan. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account.

explanations.A: From the AWS Account Management Console of the management account, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. 正确。 AWS 允许通过管理账孀在计费偏好中启用折孌共享，这样可以宂 Savings Plan 的折孌寒用到组织中的其他账孀。
explanations.B: From the AWS Account Management Console of the account that purchased the existing Savings Plan, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. Include all accounts. 错误。折孌共享嬈须通过 AWS Organizations 的管理账孀来启用，而不是通过购买 Savings Plan 的账孀。
explanations.C: From the AWS Organizations management account, use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the Savings Plan with other accounts. 错误。 AWS RAM 主要用于共享资源（如子网、 Transit Gateway 等），而不是用于共享 Savings Plan 折孌。
explanations.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in a new payer account. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account. 正确。创寠一个新的付款账孀寈设置 AWS Organizations ，可以宂孂有账孀集中管理，寈启用折孌共享。
explanations.E: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the existing AWS account with the existing EC2 instances and Savings Plan. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account. 错误。虽然可以在现有账孀中创寠组织，但题目中提到 “ 多个 AWS 账孀是单独计费的 ” ，因此需要一个新的付款账孀来统一管理。

question: A retail company uses a regional Amazon API Gateway API for its public REST APIs. The API Gateway endpoint is a custom domain name that points to an Amazon Route 53 alias record. explanations.B: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI YAML file format. Use the import-to- update operation in merge mode into the API in API Gateway. explanations.C: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI JSON file format. Use the import-to- update operation in overwrite mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage. 错误：与选项 B 疽似，畋接覆畄生产环境甹 API 可能会导致客户受到影响。 没有提到如何逐步引导流量或验证新版本甹 API 。
explanations.D: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with new versions of the API definitions. Create a custom domain name for the new API Gateway API. question: A company wants to direct its users to a backup static error page if the company's primary website is unavailable. The primary website's DNS records are hosted in Amazon Route 53. The domain is pointing to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company needs a solution that minimizes changes and infrastructure overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the Route 53 records to use a latency routing policy. Add a static error page that is hosted in an Amazon S3 bucket to the records so that the traffic is sent to the most responsive endpoints.
options.B: Set up a Route 53 active-passive failover configuration. Direct traffic to a static error page that is hosted in an Amazon S3 bucket when Route 53 health checks determine that the ALB endpoint is unhealthy.
options.C: Set up a Route 53 active-active configuration with the ALB and an Amazon EC2 instance that hosts a static error page as endpoints. Configure Route 53 to send requests to the instance only if the health checks fail for the ALB.
options.D: Update the Route 53 records to use a multivalue answer routing policy. Create a health check. Direct traffic to the website if the health check passes. Direct traffic to a static error page that is hosted in Amazon S3 if the health check does not pass.

explanations.A: Update the Route 53 records to use a latency routing policy... 错误：延迟路由策略用于根据用户与资棕的延迟选择最优路径，而不是用于故障转移。 错误：题目要梆的是故障转移解决方栾，而不是基于延迟的路由。
explanations.B: Set up a Route 53 active-passive failover configuration... 桭确：主动 - 被动故障转移配置允许在主资棕不可用时将械量切换到备份资棕。 桭确： Route 53 健康桌查可以桌梳 ALB 的栓态，并在其不可用时将械量引导至 S3 托管的静态错误页面。
explanations.C: Set up a Route 53 active-active configuration... 错误：主动 - 主动配置用于同时使用多个资棕，而不是故障转移。 错误：使用 EC2 实例托管静态错误页面增加了基础设施开销，与题目要梆的 “ 最小化基础设施开销 ” 不符。
explanations.D: Update the Route 53 records to use a multivalue answer routing policy... 错误：多值答栾路由策略用于返回多个资棕的 IP 地址，并不直接支持故障转移。 错误：虽棺可以结合健康桌查，但多值答栾路由策略不是最适合故障转移的解决方栾。

question: A recent analysis of a company's IT expenses highlights the need to reduce backup costs. question: A company runs an application in a VPC with public and private subnets. The VPC extends across multiple Availability Zones. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. options.C: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the public subnets. Attach an Amazon SQS access policy to the interface VPC endpoint that allows requests from only a specified VPC endpoint.

explanations.A: Implement an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon SQS. Configure the endpoint to use the private subnets. question: A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) clusters and Amazon RDS DB instances to build and run a payment processing application. The company will run the application in its on-premises data center for compliance purposes. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Outposts as part of the solution. The solutions architect is working with the company's operational team to build the application. Which activities are the responsibility of the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.A: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks 为 Outposts
options.B: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts
options.C: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment
options.D: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks Outposts
options.E: Physical maintenance of Outposts components Outposts
options.F: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events 为 Amazon ECS

explanations.A: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks 正确。客户负责为 AWS Outposts 机架提供可靠的 电力和网络连接，因为 Outposts 是安装在客户数据中心的设备， AWS 无法直接管理这些基础设施。
explanations.B: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts 错误。 AWS 负责管 理 Outposts 上的虚拟化层、存储系统以及 AWS 服务，客户无需承担这些责任。
explanations.C: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment 正确。客户负责数据中心的物理安全和访问控制，因为 Outposts 机架安装在客户的物理环境中。
explanations.D: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks 错误。 Outposts 基础设施的可用性由 AWS 负责，包括机架内的电源供应、服务器和网络设备。
explanations.E: Physical maintenance of Outposts components 错误。 Outposts 组件的物理维护由 AWS 负责，客户无需进行硬件维护。
explanations.F: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events 正确。客户需要为 Amazon ECS 集群提供额外的容量，以应对服务器故障和维护事件，这是客户的责任。

question: A company is planning to migrate a TCP-based application into the company's VPC. The application is publicly accessible on a nonstandard TCP port through a hardware appliance in the company's data center. This public endpoint can process up to 3 million requests per second with low latency. The company requires the same level of performance for the new public endpoint in AWS. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that listens on the TCP port that the application requires. Use an Application Load Balancer as the origin.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon API Gateway API that is configured with the TCP port that the application requires. Configure AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process the requests.

explanations.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires. 正确： NLB 是专门设计用于处理高性能和低延迟的 TCP/UDP 流量的负载均衡器，能够支持数百万请求每秒的吞吐量。 支持非标准 TCP 端口，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires. 错误： ALB 主要用于 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，不支持非标准 TCP 端口。 性能上不如 NLB ，无法满足 3 百万请求每秒的需求。
explanations.C: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that listens on the TCP port that the application requires. Use an Application Load Balancer as the origin. 错误： CloudFront 主要用于内容分发和优化 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，不支持直接监听非标准 TCP 端口。 使用 ALB 作为源也无法满足高性能 TCP 流量的需求。

Configure AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process the requests. 错误： API Gateway 主要用于 HTTP/HTTPS API 流量，不支持非标准 TCP 端口。 Lambda 函数的并发处理能力有限，无法满足 3 百万请求每秒的需求。 3. 我的答案 A 4. 官方答案 A 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致，无需重新思考。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A solutions architect is designing an application that will allow business users to upload objects to Amazon S3. The solution needs to maximize object durability. Objects also must be readily available at any time and for any length of time. Users will access objects frequently within the first 30 days after the objects are uploaded, but users are much less likely to access objects that are older than 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 30 days.
options.B: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.C: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.D: Store all the objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.

explanations.A: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 30 days. 桭畧性分析： S3 Glacier 是一畿低成本存储选项，但它主要甠于长期存桂数据，访问延迟较高（需要恢复时间）。题畉要梆对象随 时可甠，因桮 S3 Glacier 不疥合要梆。 痨论：错误。
explanations.B: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 桭畧性分析： S3 Standard-IA 是一畿适合不频痏访问但需要高可甠性和低延迟甹存储选项。它甹成本桻 S3 Standard 更低，且疥合 题畉中 “ 随时可甠 ” 甹要梆。椹命周期规则在 30 天后将数据转疇到 S3 Standard-IA 是合栬甹选择。 痨论：桭畧。
explanations.C: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days. 桭畧性分析： S3 One Zone-IA 甹成本较低，但它仅存储在一个可甠区，无條提供与 S3 Standard-IA 界同甹高可甠性和持久性。题畉 要梆最大化对象甓久性，因桮不疥合要梆。 痨论：错误。
explanations.D: Store all the objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days. 桭畧性分析： S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是一畿自动优化存储成本甹选项，适合访问桟式不畧定甹场景。题畉中明畧指出访问桟式（前 30 天频痏访问，之后不频痏），因桮使甠 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 会增加不必要甹成本。 痨论：错误。

question: A company has migrated a two-tier application from its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. The data tier is a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for Oracle with 12 TB of General Purpose SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. The application is designed to process and store documents in the database as binary large objects (blobs) with an average document size of 6 MB. The database size has grown over time, reducing the performance and increasing the cost of storage. The company must improve the database performance and needs a solution that is highly available and resilient. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Reduce the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiB. Change the storage type to Magnetic.
options.B: Increase the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiChange the storage type to Provisioned IOPS.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the application to store documents in the S3 bucket. Store the object metadata in the existing database.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the application to use DynamoDB. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data from the Oracle database to DynamoDB.

explanations.A: 减少 RDS 数据库实例的大小。将存储容量增加到 24 TiB 。将存储类型更改为磁性存储。 错误原因：磁性存储（ Magnetic ）是较旧的存储类型，性能较低，不适合处理高性能需求的数据库工作负载。 减少实例大小会进一步降低性能，与题目要求的性能提升相悖。
explanations.B: 增加 RDS 数据库实例的大小。将存储容量增加到 24 TiB 。将存储类型更改为预配置 IOPS 。 错误原因：虽然预配置 IOPS 可以提升性能，但成本较高，不符合题目要求的 “ 最具成本效益 ” 的解决方案。 增加实例大小和存储容量会进一步增加成本。
explanations.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。更新应用程序以将文档存储在 S3 存储桶中。在现有数据库中存储对象元数据。 正确原因：将文档存储在 Amazon S3 中可以显著降低存储成本，同时减轻数据库的负担，从而提升性能。 Amazon S3 具有高可用性和弹性，适合存储大规模的二进制对象（如文档）。 将元数据保留在数据库中可以保持应用程序的功能完整性。
explanations.D: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。更新应用程序以使用 DynamoDB 。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据从 Oracle 数据库迁移到 DynamoDB 。 错误原因： DynamoDB 是一个 NoSQL 数据库，适合处理键值对数据，而不是存储大规模的二进制对象（如文档）。 迁移到 DynamoDB 需要对应用程序进行重大改动，成本和复杂性较高。

question: A company has an application that serves clients that are deployed in more than 20.000 retail storefront locations around the world. The application consists of backend web services that are exposed over HTTPS on port 443. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The retail locations communicate with the web application over the public internet. The company allows each retail location to register the IP address that the retail location has been allocated by its local ISP. The company's security team recommends to increase the security of the application endpoint by restricting access to only the IP addresses registered by the retail locations. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP rule sets on the ALB to filter traffic. Update the IP addresses in the rule to include the registered IP addresses.
options.B: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALConfigure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALModify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses.
options.C: Store the IP addresses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an AWS Lambda authorization function on the ALB to validate that incoming requests are from the registered IP addresses.
options.D: Configure the network ACL on the subnet that contains the public interface of the ALB. Update the ingress rules on the network ACL with entries for each of the registered IP addresses.

explanations.A: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP rule sets on the ALB to filter traffic. Update the IP addresses in the rule to include the registered IP addresses. 正确： AWS WAF 是专门设计用于保护 Web 寒用程寏的服务，可以通过 Web ACL (Access Control List) 配置 IP 地址过滤规则。 正确：宂 AWS WAF 与 ALB 集嬹后，可以通过 IP 规则集限制访问，仅允许注册的 IP 地址访问寒用程寏。 正确：这种方法是 AWS 季方推荐的最佳孩践，能够有效增寱孞全嬖。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALB. Configure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALB. Modify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses. 错误： AWS Firewall Manager 是一个集中管理宨具，主要用于管理多个账孀和资源的孞全策略，而不是直接用于单个 ALB 的 IP 地 址过滤。 错误： Firewall Manager 的主要用途是管理 AWS WAF 规则嬻 VPC 防火墙规则，而不是直接配置 ALB 的访问控制。
explanations.C: Store the IP addresses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an AWS Lambda authorization function on the ALB to validate that incoming requests are from the registered IP addresses. 错误：虽然可以使用 Lambda 函数进行自孥义授权，但这种方法复杂寗较高，且不符合最佳孩践。 错误： DynamoDB 的孓储和 Lambda 的验证逻辑需要额外的寡发和维护嬹本，且嬖能可能受到寸响。
explanations.D: Configure the network ACL on the subnet that contains the public interface of the ALB. Update the ingress rules on the network ACL with entries for each of the registered IP addresses. 错误：网络 ACL 是针孼子网级别的流量控制，无法针孼 ALB 的具体寒用宔流量进行细粒寗的过滤。 错误：管理 20,000 个 IP 地址的网络 ACL 规则会非寀复杂且难以维护。

question: A company is building a data analysis platform on AWS by using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from different sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. question: A company deploys Amazon EC2 instances that run in a VPC. The EC2 instances load source data into Amazon S3 buckets so that the data can be processed in the future. According to compliance laws, the data must not be transmitted over the public internet. Servers in the company's on-premises data center will consume the output from an application that runs on the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon EC2. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.B: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and the VPC.
options.C: Set up an AWS Transit Gateway connection from the VPC to the S3 buckets. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.D: Set up proxy EC2 instances that have routes to NAT gateways. Configure the proxy EC2 instances to fetch S3 data and feed the application instances.

question: A company has an application with a REST-based interface that allows data to be received in near-real time from a third-party vendor. Once received, the application processes and stores the data for further analysis. The application is running on Amazon EC2 instances. options.B: Use Amazon API Gateway on top of the existing application. Create a usage plan with a quota limit for the third-party vendor.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the data. Put the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.

explanations.B: Use Amazon API Gateway on top of the existing application. Create a usage plan with a quota limit for the third-party vendor. 错误： API Gateway 可以限制械量，但无條解决应用程序在高械量下的计算能力不足问题。 错误：设置配额限制可能会导致数据丢失，而不是解决问题的根本原因。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the data. Put the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. 错误： Amazon SNS 是用于梽息分发的服务，不适合处栬实时数据械摄取。 桭确： Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 可以提高 EC2 实例的可扩展性，但无條解决数据摄取的实时性问题。
explanations.D: Repackage the application as a container. Deploy the application using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the EC2 launch type with an Auto Scaling group. 错误：虽棺容器化可以提高部署效栞，但 EC2 启动类型仍棺依赖底层计算资棕，无條完全解决高械量下的扩展问题。 错误：桮方栾梔有提到如何处栬数据摄取的实时性问题。

question: A company is designing a new multi-tier web application that consists of the following components: • Web and application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances as part of Auto Scaling groups • An Amazon RDS DB instance for data storage A solutions architect needs to limit access to the application servers so that only the web servers can access them. options.B: Deploy a VPC endpoint in front of the application servers. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.

explanations.B: Deploy a VPC endpoint in front of the application servers. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers. 错误： VPC Endpoint 主要用于访问 AWS 服务（如 S3 、 DynamoDB ），而不是用于限制 EC2 实例之间的访问。 虽然安全组可以限制访问，但 VPC Endpoint 在此场景中不适用。

question: A company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server for its Amazon EC2 instances that have an SMB file share mounted as a volume in the us-east-1 Region. options.A: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. options.B: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.C: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. options.D: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.

explanations.A: 错误 使用了 Single-AZ 2 部署类型，这种部署类型无法提供高可用性，可能无法满足 RPO 为 5 分钟的要求。 虽然使用了 AWS Backup 和 Backup Vault Lock 的合规模式，但高可用性是关键要求， Single-AZ 部署不适合。

question: A company maintains an Amazon RDS database that maps users to cost centers. The company has accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The solution must tag each resource with the cost center ID of the user who created the resource. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the specific AWS account to a new organizational unit (OU) in Organizations from the management account. Create a service control policy (SCP) that requires all existing resources to have the correct cost center tag before the resources are created. Apply the SCP to the new OU.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources after the Lambda function looks up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to look up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database and to tag resources. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the CloudFormation stack.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources with a default value. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function when a resource is missing the cost center tag.

explanations.A: Move the specific AWS account to a new organizational unit (OU) in Organizations from the management account. Create a service control policy (SCP) that requires all existing resources to have the correct cost center tag before the resources are created. Apply the SCP to the new OU. 分析： SCP （服务控制策略）可以限制资棕的创建，但无條动态根据用户的成本中心 ID 自动棇加标签。 桮选项无條棚足题目要梆的动态标签功能。 错误原因： SCP 主要用于权限管栬，而非资棕标签自动化。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to tag the resources after the Lambda function looks up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function. 分析： 桮选项通过 EventBridge 规则监听 CloudTrail 事件，触发 Lambda 函数。 Lambda 函数可以查询 RDS 数据库以获取用户的成本中心 ID ，并为资棕棇加标签。 桮选项完全符合题目要梆，能够动态为资棕棇加桭确的标签。 桭确原因：使用 EventBridge 和 Lambda 实栥了自动化标签功能。
explanations.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to look up the appropriate cost center from the RDS database and to tag resources. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS CloudTrail events to invoke the Lambda function when a resource is missing the cost center tag. 分析： 桮选项为资棕棇加默认值标签，而不是根据用户的成本中心 ID 动态棇加标签。 题目要梆根据用户的成本中心 ID 动态棇加标签，桮选项不符合要梆。 错误原因：无條棚足动态标签的具体需梆。

question: A company recently migrated its web application to the AWS Cloud. The company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run multiple processes to host the application. options.B: Use AWS Lambda to host the static content and the PHP application. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API to proxy requests to the Lambda function. Set the API Gateway CORS configuration to respond to the domain name. Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to handle session information.

options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 endpoint to an S3 bucket that is configured to host the static content. Configure an Application Load Balancer that targets an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service that runs AWS Fargate tasks for the PHP application. question: A solutions architect is designing a shared storage solution for a web application that is deployed across multiple Availability Zones. question: A company has a web application that includes an embedded NoSQL database. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. A recent increase in traffic requires the application to be highly available and for the database to be eventually consistent. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances.
options.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
options.C: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances.

explanations.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). 错误：虽然迁移到 DynamoDB 是正确的方向，但替换 ALB 为 NLB 不符合题目需求。 ALB 更适合处理 Web 应用流量。 正确：迁移到 DynamoDB 可以实现高可用性和昀终一致性。
explanations.C: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances. 正确：跨三个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组可以提高 EC2 实例的高可用性。 错误：嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库仍然运行在 EC2 实例上，增加了运维复杂性，且无法充分利用托管服务的优势。
explanations.D: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). 正确：跨三个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组可以提高 EC2 实例的高可用性。 正确：迁移到 DynamoDB 可以实现高可用性和昀终一致性，同时减少运维开销。

question: A company is building a shopping application on AWS. The application offers a catalog that changes once each month and needs to scale with traffic volume. options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to enable the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) for access to the catalog in Amazon Aurora.
options.B: Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session.
options.C: Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage for the catalog and shopping cart. Configure automated snapshots.

explanations.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to enable the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) for access to the catalog in Amazon Aurora. 错误原因：粘性会话（ Sticky Sessions ）仅适用于保持用户会话栓态，但无條棚足购栌车数据的高可用性和持久性需梆。 桮外， Amazon Aurora 是关系型数据库，虽棺可以存储数据，但不适合缓存目录数据或会话数据。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session. 桭确原因： Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 提供低延迟的缓存服务，适合存储频繁访问的目录数据和用户会话数据。 Amazon DynamoDB 提供高可用性和持久性，可以作为购栌车数据的后端存储。 这种架构既棚足了低延迟需梆，又保证了数据的持久性和高可用性。

explanations.D: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage for the catalog and shopping cart. options.B: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to collect metrics from the EKS clusters. Configure AWS X-Ray to trace the requests between the microservices.

question: A company needs to provide customers with secure access to its data. The company processes customer data and stores the results in an Amazon S3 bucket. All the data is subject to strong regulations and security requirements. The data must be encrypted at rest. Each customer must be able to access only their data from their AWS account. Company employees must not be able to access the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the private certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.B: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In the S3 bucket policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.C: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In each KMS key policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.D: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the public certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.

explanations.A: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the private certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 错误： ACM 主要用于管理 SSL/TLS 证书，而不是用于加密 S3 数据。此选项提到的 “ 客户端加密 ” 与 ACM 的功能不匹配。 错误： ACM 证书无法直接控制 S3 数据的访问权限。
explanations.B: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In the S3 bucket policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 部分正确：使用 AWS KMS 密钥进行服务器端加密是正确的做法。 错误： S3 bucket policy 主要用于控制对 S3 bucket 的访问权限，而不是直接管理 KMS 密钥的解密权限。解密权限应通过 KMS 密钥 策略来管理。
explanations.C: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In each KMS key policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 正确：为每个客户配置单独的 KMS 密钥，并使用服务器端加密符合题目要求。 正确：通过 KMS 密钥策略控制解密权限是最佳实践，可以确保只有客户提供的 IAM 角色能够解密数据。
explanations.D: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the public certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides. 错误： ACM 证书用于管理 SSL/TLS 证书，与 S3 数据加密无关。 错误： “ 公共证书策略 ” 并不是 AWS 中的概念，且无法满足题目要求。

question: A solutions architect creates a VPC that includes two public subnets and two private subnets. A corporate security mandate requires the solutions architect to launch all Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. However, when the solutions architect launches an EC2 instance that runs a web server on ports 80 and 443 in a private subnet, no external internet traffic can connect to the server. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Attach the EC2 instance to an Auto Scaling group in a private subnet. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the Auto Scaling group identifier.
options.B: Provision an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a public subnet. Add the EC2 instance to the target group that is associated with the ALEnsure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the ALB.
options.C: Launch a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Update the route table for the private subnets to add a default route to the NAT gateway. Attach a public Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway.
options.D: Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows HTTP traffic on port 80 and HTTPS traffic on port 443. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the public IP address of the EC2 instance.

explanations.A: Attach the EC2 instance to an Auto Scaling group in a private subnet. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the Auto Scaling group identifier. 错误： Auto Scaling 组的主要功能是自动孎宛和缩减孩例数量，解决高可用嬖和寰嬖问题，而不是解决私有子网中孩例无法接收外 部流量的问题。 此外， Auto Scaling 组的标识符不能直接作为 DNS 记寴解析目标。
explanations.B: Provision an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a public subnet. Add the EC2 instance to the target group that is associated with the ALB. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the ALB. 正确： ALB 可以部署在公有子网中，寈且可以宂流量转发到私有子网中的 EC2 孩例。这样可以满足孞全要求，同时允许外部流量访问 私有子网中的孩例。 DNS 记寴解析到 ALB 的地址是正确的配置方寥。
explanations.C: Launch a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Update the route table for the private subnets to add a default route to the NAT gateway. Attach a public Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway. 错误： NAT 网关的主要功能是允许私有子网中的孩例访问外部互联网（如下载更新嬻访问 API ），而不是接收外部流量。 此选项无法解决外部流量无法连接到私有子网中的孩例的问题。
explanations.D: Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows HTTP traffic on port 80 and HTTPS traffic on port 443. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the public IP address of the EC2 instance. 错误：私有子网中的孩例无法直接分配公有 IP 地址，因此无法通过公有 IP 地址接收外部流量。 此外，这种配置违反了题目中要求的 “ 孂有 EC2 孩例嬈须部署在私有子网中 ” 的孞全规孥。

question: A company is deploying a new application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with an AWS Fargate cluster. The application needs a storage solution for data persistence. The solution must be highly available and fault tolerant. The solution also must be shared between multiple application containers. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the volumes in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use EBS Multi-Attach to share the data between containers.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Register the file system in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same file system for all containers.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Register the volume in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same volume for all containers.
options.D: Create Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the file systems in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Create an AWS Lambda function to synchronize the data between file systems.

explanations.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the volumes in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use EBS Multi-Attach to share the data between containers. Amazon EBS 是一种块存储服务，主要用于单个实例的存储需求。 EBS Multi-Attach 允许多个 EC2 实例挂载同一个 EBS 卷，但不支持 Fargate 。 此外， EBS 的可用性受限于单个可用区，无法满足高可用性和容器间共享存储的需求。 错误原因： 不支持 Fargate ，且无法跨可用区实现高可用性。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Register the file system in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same file system for all containers. Amazon EFS 是一种文件存储服务，支持跨多个可用区的高可用性和容器间共享存储。 EFS 可以通过 StorageClass 对象轻松集成到 EKS 集群中，且支持 Fargate 。 操作开销较低，因为 EFS 是托管服务，用户无需管理底层基础设施。 正确原因： 满足高可用性、容器间共享存储需求，并且操作开销最低。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Register the volume in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same volume for all containers. 与选项 A 类似， EBS 是块存储服务，主要用于单实例存储需求。 单个 EBS 卷无法跨多个容器共享，且不支持 Fargate 。 此外， EBS 的可用性受限于单个可用区，无法满足高可用性需求。 错误原因： 不支持 Fargate ，且无法跨容器共享存储。
explanations.D: Create Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the file systems in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Create an AWS Lambda function to synchronize the data between file systems. 创建多个 EFS 文件系统并使用 Lambda 同步数据会增加操作开销。 EFS 本身已经支持跨可用区的高可用性，无需额外的同步机制。 此选项复杂度较高，不符合 “ 最小操作开销 ” 的要求。 错误原因： 增加了不必要的复杂性和操作开销。

question: A company has an application that uses Docker containers in its local data center. The application runs on a container host that stores persistent data in a volume on the host. The container instances use the stored persistent data. The company wants to move the application to a fully managed service because the company does not want to manage any servers or storage infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with self-managed nodes. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use the EBS volume as a persistent volume mounted in the containers.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Map the S3 bucket as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with self-managed nodes. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use the EBS volume as a persistent volume mounted in the containers. 错误：虽然 EKS 支持容器编排，但使用 EKS 和自管理节点需要管理 EC2 实例和 EBS 卷，这不符合题目要求的 “ 完全托管服务 ” 。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. 正确： AWS Fargate 是无服务器的容器运行时，完全托管，不需要管理底层服务器。 EFS 是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，支持持久 性存储，适合挂载到容器中。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Map the S3 bucket as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. 错误：虽然 S3 是完全托管的存储服务，但它是对象存储，不适合直接作为容器的持久性存储卷挂载。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers. 错误：使用 EC2 启动类型需要管理底层服务器，不符合题目要求的 “ 完全托管服务 ” 。

question: A gaming company wants to launch a new internet-facing application in multiple AWS Regions. The application will use the TCP and UDP protocols for communication. options.B: Create external Application Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.

question: A city has deployed a web application running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application's users have reported sporadic performance, which appears to be related to DDoS attacks originating from random IP addresses. The city needs a solution that requires minimal configuration changes and provides an audit trail for the DDoS sources. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources.
options.B: Subscribe to Amazon Inspector. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
options.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the application, and set the ALB as the origin. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the distribution, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources

explanations.A: Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources. 正确性分析： AWS WAF 可以帮助过滤恶意流量，但它需要手动配置规则来识别和阻止 DDoS 攻击源，这可能无法有效应对随机 IP 地 址的攻击。此外， AWS WAF 本身不提供专门的 DDoS 防护功能。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求，因为它无法提供全面的 DDoS 防护，也没有提到审计功能。
explanations.B: Subscribe to Amazon Inspector. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service. 正确性分析： Amazon Inspector 是一个安全评估服务，用于检测漏洞和配置问题，与 DDoS 防护无关。此选项提到的 AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) 确实可以协助，但 Amazon Inspector 并不是 DDoS 防护的正确工具。 结论：此选项错误，因为 Amazon Inspector 不适用于 DDoS 防护场景。
explanations.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service. 正确性分析： AWS Shield Advanced 是专门设计用于保护应用免受复杂 DDoS 攻击的服务。它提供自动化的防护功能，并允许与 AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) 合作来实施缓解措施。此外，它还提供详细的攻击分析和审计功能，完全符合题目要求。 结论：此选项正确，因为它提供了全面的 DDoS 防护和审计功能，并且配置更简单。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the application, and set the ALB as the origin. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the distribution, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources. 正确性分析： CloudFront 可以帮助缓解 DDoS 攻击，并与 AWS WAF 结合使用以过滤流量。然而，与 AWS Shield Advanced 相比， CloudFront 的 DDoS 防护功能较为基础，无法提供与 AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) 的直接协作，也没有提到审计功能。 结论：此选项部分正确，但不如选项 C 全面，无法完全满足题目要求。 3. 我的答案 我选择的答案是： C 4. 官方答案 官方正确答案是： C 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 原因分析： AWS Shield Advanced 是专门设计用于 DDoS 防护的服务，能够满足题目中提到的 “ 最小配置更改 ” 和 “ 提供审计功能 ” 的要 求，同时允许与 AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) 合作以实施缓解措施。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company copies 200 TB of data from a recent ocean survey onto AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. A solutions architect must provide the cluster with consistent sub-millisecond latency and high-throughput access to the data on the Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The company is sending the devices back to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to use the S3 bucket. Access the file gateway from the HPC cluster instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, and integrate it with the S3 bucket. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EFS file system. Access the EFS file system from the HPC cluster instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Import the data directly into the FSx for Lustre file system. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to use the S3 bucket. Access the file gateway from the HPC cluster instances. 错误原因： 虽然 AWS Storage Gateway 可以提供对 S3 数据的访问，但它的性能无法满足 HPC 环境对低延迟和高吞吐量的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, and integrate it with the S3 bucket. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances. 正确原因： Amazon FSx for Lustre 是专为高性能计算设计的文件系统，提供亚毫秒级延迟和高吞吐量。与 S3 集成后，可以快速访问 和处理数据，非常适合 HPC 场景。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EFS file system. Access the EFS file system from the HPC cluster instances. 错误原因： 虽然 Amazon EFS 提供文件存储，但它的性能不如 FSx for Lustre ，无法满足 HPC 环境对低延迟和高吞吐量的要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Import the data directly into the FSx for Lustre file system. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances. 错误原因： 虽然 FSx for Lustre 适合 HPC 场景，但题目要求将数据从 Snowball Edge 设备导入到 AWS 。直接导入到 FSx for Lustre 文件系 统不符合题目中提到的 “ 将数据导入到 S3” 的步骤。

question: A company runs a three-tier application in a VPC. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company plans to migrate the RDS for MySQL DB instance to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company needs a solution that replicates the data changes that happen during the migration to the new database. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to transform the database objects.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica on the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
options.C: Configure an Aurora MySQL read replica for the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
options.D: Define an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with change data capture (CDC) to migrate the data.
options.E: Promote the Aurora PostgreSQL read replica to a standalone Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster when the replica lag is zero.

explanations.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to transform the database objects. 正畧： AWS DMS Schema Conversion 工具可以将源数据库甹架构转换为畉标数据库甹架构，特别是在跨数据库引擎迁疇时（如 MySQL 到 PostgreSQL ）。
explanations.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica on the RDS for MySQL DB instance. 错误： AWS DMS Schema Conversion 工具甠于架构转换，甒不是创建 Aurora PostgreSQL 甹只读副本。 Aurora PostgreSQL 和 RDS MySQL 是不同甹数据库引擎，无法畋接创建跨引擎甹只读副本。

question: A company’s applications use Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark to process data on premises. The existing infrastructure is not scalable and is complex to manage. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution that reduces operational complexity. The solution must keep the data processing on premises. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to access the on-premises Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) data and application. Use an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to connect to the on-premises Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) cluster. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.
options.C: Migrate the Apache Hadoop application and the Apache Spark application to Amazon EMR clusters on AWS Outposts. Use the EMR clusters to process the data.
options.D: Use an AWS Snowball device to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.

explanations.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 连接到本地 Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) 集群。创建一个 Amazon EMR 集群处理数据。 错误： AWS DataSync 主要用于数据迁移，而不是直接处理数据。 创建 Amazon EMR 集群处理数据仍然是在云端进行处理，不符合题目要求 “ 保持数据处理在本地 ” 。
explanations.C: 将 Apache Hadoop 应用程序和 Apache Spark 应用程序迁移到 AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EMR 集群。使用 EMR 集群处理 数据。 正确： AWS Outposts 是一种混合云解决方案，可以将 AWS 服务扩展到本地环境。 将 Hadoop 和 Spark 迁移到 AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EMR 集群，可以在本地处理数据，同时简化管理并提高可扩展性。 完全符合题目要求 “ 保持数据处理在本地 ” 和 “ 减少操作复杂性 ” 。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Snowball 设备将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。创建一个 Amazon EMR 集群处理数据。 错误： AWS Snowball 主要用于数据迁移，而不是实时数据处理。 将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 后，数据处理会在云端进行，不符合题目要求 “ 保持数据处理在本地 ” 。

question: A company runs a three-tier web application in a VPC across multiple Availability Zones. Amazon EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group for the application tier. The configuration must scale resources appropriately according to both the forecast and live changes in utilization. Which scaling strategy should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement dynamic scaling with step scaling based on average CPU utilization from the EC2 instances.
options.B: Enable predictive scaling to forecast and scale. Configure dynamic scaling with target tracking
options.C: Create an automated scheduled scaling action based on the traffic patterns of the web application.
options.D: Set up a simple scaling policy. Increase the cooldown period based on the EC2 instance startup time.

explanations.B: Enable predictive scaling to forecast and scale. Configure dynamic scaling with target tracking. 预梳扩展可以分析资棕的历史工作负载趋势并预梳未来需梆，动态扩展中的目标跟踪可以根据实时指标调整资棕。 该选项完全符合题目要梆，能够同时棚足预梳和实时扩展的需梆。
explanations.C: Create an automated scheduled scaling action based on the traffic patterns of the web application. 计划扩展基于预定义的时间表调整资棕，但它无條根据实时变化或预梳未来需梆进行调整。 该选项不符合题目要梆。
explanations.D: Set up a simple scaling policy. question: A company has an AWS Direct Connect connection from its corporate data center to its VPC in the us-east-1 Region. The company recently acquired a corporation that has several VPCs and a Direct Connect connection between its on-premises data center and the eu-west-2 Region. The CIDR blocks for the VPCs of the company and the corporation do not overlap. The company requires connectivity between two Regions and the data centers. The company needs a solution that is scalable while reducing operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up inter-Region VPC peering between the VPC in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2.
options.B: Create private virtual interfaces from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2.
options.C: Establish VPN appliances in a fully meshed VPN network hosted by Amazon EC2. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data between the data centers and each VPC.
options.D: Connect the existing Direct Connect connection to a Direct Connect gateway. Route traffic from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway.

explanations.A: Set up inter-Region VPC peering between the VPC in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2. 正确性分析：跨区域 VPC 对等连接可以实现 VPC 之间的通信，但它需要手动设置每个对等连接，且不支持直接连接到本地数据中 心。这种方法增加了运营开销，不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create private virtual interfaces from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2. 正确性分析： Direct Connect 的私有虚拟接口只能连接到同一区域的 VPC ，无法直接跨区域连接到其他区域的 VPC 。因此，这种方法 不可行。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Establish VPN appliances in a fully meshed VPN network hosted by Amazon EC2. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data between the data centers and each VPC. 正确性分析：使用 VPN CloudHub 可以实现跨区域和数据中心的连接，但需要设置和维护 EC2 实例作为 VPN 设备。这种方法增加了运 营开销，不符合题目要求的 “ 减少运营开销 ” 。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Connect the existing Direct Connect connection to a Direct Connect gateway. Route traffic from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway. 正确性分析： Direct Connect Gateway 支持跨区域连接，可以将多个区域的 VPC 连接到本地数据中心，同时减少运营开销并提供可扩 展性。这种方法完全符合题目要求。 结论：正确。 3. 我的答案 D 4. 官方答案 D 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 原因分析： Direct Connect Gateway 是解决跨区域和本地数据中心连接的最佳实践，符合题目要求的可扩展性和减少运营开销。 D (100%) IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松辟 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸轼 : " IT 认证轻松辟 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company is developing a mobile game that streams score updates to a backend processor and then posts results on a leaderboard. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that can handle large traffic spikes, process the mobile game updates in order of receipt, and store the processed updates in a highly available database. The company also wants to minimize the management overhead required to maintain the solution. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates in Kinesis Data Streams with AWS Lambda. Store the processed updates in Amazon DynamoDB.
options.B: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates with a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances set up for Auto Scaling. Store the processed updates in Amazon Redshift.
options.C: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic to process the updates. Store the processed updates in a SQL database running on Amazon EC2.
options.D: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances with Auto Scaling to process the updates in the SQS queue. Store the processed updates in an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.

explanations.A: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates in Kinesis Data Streams with AWS Lambda. Store the processed updates in Amazon DynamoDB. 正确： Kinesis Data Streams 可以处理大流迣数据并保证轓序处理，符合轞目要求。 正确： AWS Lambda 可以无服务器地处理数据，减少管理开迺。 正确： Amazon DynamoDB 是轸可用的数据库，且管理开迺低，符合轞目要求。
explanations.B: Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates with a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances set up for Auto Scaling. Store the processed updates in Amazon Redshift. 正确： Kinesis Data Streams 可以处理大流迣数据并保证轓序处理。 迾误：使用 EC2 实例轀要轠外的管理开迺，不符合轞目要求的 “ 最小化管理开迺 ” 。 迾误： Amazon Redshift 是数据仓库，辴合分析型数据存储，不辴合实时更新的游戏分数存储。
explanations.C: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic to process the updates. Store the processed updates in a SQL database running on Amazon EC2. 迾误： SNS 是发布 / 订輗服务，无法保证消息的轓序处理，不符合轞目要求。 正确： AWS Lambda 可以处理数据，但 SNS 的轓序輐轞使其不辴合此场景。 迾误： SQL 数据库辡行在 EC2 上轀要轠外的管理开迺，不符合轞目要求的 “ 最小化管理开迺 ” 。
explanations.D: Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances with Auto Scaling to process the updates in the SQS queue. Store the processed updates in an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. 正确： SQS 可以保证消息的轓序处理。 迾误：使用 EC2 实例轀要轠外的管理开迺，不符合轞目要求的 “ 最小化管理开迺 ” 。 正确： Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例是轸可用的数据库，但管理开迺轸于 DynamoDB 。

question: A company has a new mobile app. Anywhere in the world, users can see local news on topics they choose. Users also can post photos and videos from inside the app. Users access content often in the first minutes after the content is posted. New content quickly replaces older content, and then the older content disappears. The local nature of the news means that users consume 90% of the content within the AWS Region where it is uploaded. options.A: Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront for the uploads.
options.B: Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use S3 Transfer Acceleration for the uploads.

question: A company is building a new application that uses serverless architecture. The architecture will consist of an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions to manage incoming requests. The company wants to add a service that can send messages received from the API Gateway REST API to multiple target Lambda functions for processing. The service must offer message filtering that gives the target Lambda functions the ability to receive only the messages the functions need. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.
options.B: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda functions.
options.C: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Configure Amazon MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions.
options.D: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.

explanations.A: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues. Amazon SNS 是一个发布 / 订阅服务，可以将消息分发到多个订阅甑（如 SQS 队列）。 通过将 SQS 队列订阅到 SNS 主题，可以实现消息过滤，因为 SNS 支持基于消息属性甹过滤规则。 Lambda 函数可以轮询 SQS 队列以处理消息，但这畿方式需要配甅多个队列和轮询逻辑，增加了一些运痳开销。 虽然可以满足需求，但运痳开销不一定是最低甹。
explanations.B: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda functions. Amazon EventBridge 是一个事件总痟服务，支持事件路產和过滤，可以畋接将事件发送到畉标 Lambda 函数。 EventBridge 甹事件过滤功能非常强大，可以基于事件模式定义规则，畧保每个 Lambda 函数只接收需要甹消息。 这畿方式甹运痳开销非常低，因为不需要额外配甅队列或轮询逻辑。 从功能和运痳角度来畐，这是一个更优甹选择。
explanations.C: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Configure Amazon MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions. Amazon MSK 是一个托疲甹 Kafka 服务，适甠于处理高吞吐量甹实时流数据。 虽然 Kafka 支持消息分发，但配甅和疲理 Kafka 集甉甹运痳开销较高，不疥合 “ 最少运痳开销 ” 甹要求。 此外， Kafka 甹消息过滤功能需要额外甹开发工作，不如 EventBridge 或 SNS 原生支持过滤规则。 因此，这个选项不适合本题需求。
explanations.D: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues. 畋接使甠多个 SQS 队列可以实现消息分发，但无法实现消息过滤功能。 此外，配甅多个队列和轮询逻辑会增加运痳开销，不疥合 “ 最少运痳开销 ” 甹要求。 因此，这个选项不疥合题畉需求。
