question: A solutions architect is designing an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) authorization model for a company's AWS account. The company has designated five specific employees to have full access to AWS services and resources in the AWS account. The solutions architect has created an IAM user for each of the five designated employees and has created an IAM user group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Attach the AdministratorAccess resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.B: Attach the SystemAdministrator identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.C: Attach the AdministratorAccess identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.D: Attach the SystemAdministrator resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.

explanations.A: Attach the AdministratorAccess resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 错误：资源基于策略（ Resource-based policy ）是直接附加到资源上的，而不是附加到用户组或用户。 IAM 用户组无法使用资源基 于策略。
explanations.B: Attach the SystemAdministrator identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 错误： AWS 中没有名为 “SystemAdministrator” 的预定义策略。此选项无效。
explanations.C: Attach the AdministratorAccess identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 正确： AdministratorAccess 是 AWS 提供的预定义策略，授予完全访问权限。将此策略附加到 IAM 用户组，并将用户添加到该组，可 以满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Attach the SystemAdministrator resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group. 错误：资源基于策略（ Resource-based policy ）无法附加到 IAM 用户组。此外， “SystemAdministrator” 不是 AWS 的预定义策略。

question: A company has a multi-tier payment processing application that is based on virtual machines (VMs). The communication between the tiers occurs asynchronously through a third-party middleware solution that guarantees exactly-once delivery. The company needs a solution that requires the least amount of infrastructure management. The solution must guarantee exactly- once delivery for application messaging. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Lambda for the compute layers in the architecture.
options.B: Use Amazon EC2 instances for the compute layers in the architecture.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) as the messaging component between the compute layers.
options.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the messaging component between the compute layers.
options.E: Use containers that are based on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) for the compute layers in the architecture.

explanations.A: Use AWS Lambda for the compute layers in the architecture. 正确： AWS Lambda 是无服务器计算服务，减少了基础设施管理需求，符合题目要求的 “ 最少的基础设施管理 ” 。 此外， Lambda 可以与 SQS FIFO 队列集成，支持 Exactly-once delivery 。
explanations.B: Use Amazon EC2 instances for the compute layers in the architecture. 错误： EC2 实例需要手动管理基础设施（如操作系统、扩展、维护等），不符合题目要求的 “ 最少的基础设施管理 ” 。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) as the messaging component between the compute layers. 错误： Amazon SNS 是发布 / 订阅消息服务，不支持 Exactly-once delivery 。它提供的是 “ 至少一次 ” 消息传递，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the messaging component between the compute layers. 正确： Amazon SQS FIFO 队列支持 Exactly-once delivery ，符合题目要求。 此外， SQS FIFO 队列可以与 Lambda 集成，进一步减少基础设施管理需求。
explanations.E: Use containers that are based on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) for the compute layers in the architecture. 错误： Amazon EKS 需要管理容器编排和集群基础设施，增加了管理复杂性，不符合题目要求的 “ 最少的基础设施管理 ” 。

question: A company has a nightly batch processing routine that analyzes report files that an on-premises file system receives daily through SFTP. The company wants to move the solution to the AWS Cloud. The solution must be highly available and resilient. The solution also must minimize operational effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1.
options.D: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. Modify the application to pull the batch files from Amazon S3 to an Amazon EC2 instance for processing. Use an EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation.

explanations.A: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation. 分析： AWS Transfer for SFTP 是一个托管服务，能够轻松地接收 SFTP 文件，减少了管理 SFTP 服务器的操作工作量。 Amazon EFS 是一个高可用、弹性且可扩展的文件存储服务，适合存储批处理文件。 使用 Auto Scaling 组和计划扩展策略可以确保批处理操作的高可用性和弹性。 此选项符合题目要求：高可用性、弹性和最小化操作工作量。 结论： 正确。
explanations.B: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1. 分析： 运行 SFTP 服务需要手动管理 EC2 实例和 SFTP 服务器，增加了操作工作量。 Amazon EBS 是单实例存储，无法提供高可用性和弹性。 Auto Scaling 组设置最小实例数和期望实例数为 1 ，无法实现弹性扩展。 此选项不符合题目要求：高可用性和最小化操作工作量。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1. 分析： 运行 SFTP 服务需要手动管理 EC2 实例和 SFTP 服务器，增加了操作工作量。 Amazon EFS 提供高可用性和弹性，但手动管理 SFTP 服务仍然是一个问题。 Auto Scaling 组设置最小实例数和期望实例数为 1 ，无法实现弹性扩展。 此选项部分符合题目要求，但未能最小化操作工作量。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. Modify the application to pull the batch files from Amazon S3 to an Amazon EC2 instance for processing. Use an EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation. 分析： AWS Transfer for SFTP 是托管服务，减少了操作工作量。 Amazon S3 是高可用、弹性且成本低的存储服务，但需要修改应用程序以支持从 S3 拉取文件，增加了开发工作量。 使用 Auto Scaling 组和计划扩展策略可以确保批处理操作的高可用性和弹性。 此选项符合高可用性和弹性要求，但增加了开发工作量，未能完全最小化操作工作量。 结论： 错误。

question: A company has users all around the world accessing its HTTP-based application deployed on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. The company wants to improve the availability and performance of the application. The company also wants to protect the application against common web exploits that may affect availability, compromise security, or consume excessive resources. Static IP addresses are required. What should a solutions architect recommend to accomplish this?

options.A: Put the EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the NLBs. Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator and register the NLBs as endpoints.
options.B: Put the EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the ALBs. Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator and register the ALBs as endpoints.
options.C: Put the EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the NLBs.
options.D: Put the EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the ALBs. Deploy AWS WAF on the CloudFront distribution.

explanations.A: Put the EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the NLBs. Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator and register the NLBs as endpoints. 正确性分析： NLB 支持静态 IP 地址， AWS Global Accelerator 可以提供全球加速和静态 IP 地址，但 NLB 不支持直接与 AWS WAF 集成。 AWS WAF 通常与 ALB 或 CloudFront 集成，因此此选项在安全性方面不符合要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Put the EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the ALBs. Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator and register the ALBs as endpoints. 正确性分析： ALB 支持与 AWS WAF 集成，可以保护应用免受常见的网络攻击。 AWS Global Accelerator 提供静态 IP 地址和全球加速功 能。此选项满足所有需求，包括性能优化、安全性和静态 IP 地址。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Put the EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the NLBs. 正确性分析： NLB 不支持与 AWS WAF 直接集成，因此安全性需求无法满足。此外， CloudFront 分发和 Route 53 的延迟路由可以优化 性能，但无法提供静态 IP 地址。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Put the EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the ALBs. Deploy AWS WAF on the CloudFront distribution. 正确性分析： CloudFront 可以与 AWS WAF 集成，提供安全性保护，但 CloudFront 无法提供静态 IP 地址。此外， Route 53 的延迟路由 可以优化性能，但不满足静态 IP 地址的需求。 结论：错误。
